messages:
Mia (People Ops): FYI new cohort starting Mon — need to confirm I-9s + background checks are cleared for 5 hires. Quick sync thread so we don't scramble on D0.

Raj (Talent Ops): Got list. I'll ping GoodHire for any outstanding docs. Who's Owner for D0 orientation?

Mia (People Ops): @Chris will run the first 30m 'team intro', @Olivia legal will cover policy signoffs, I'll do HR forms and benefits quickstart. Need a volunteer to do IT kick-off (accounts, slack, key access). @Sam?

Chris (Eng Manager): I can do team intro at 10:00 PT. Can someone share the D0 schedule link? Also confirm remote hires need webcam check.

Onboarding-bot: New hire packet sent to: emma.k, rafael.m, tayla.s, devin.h, sheng.l — background check status: 3 complete, 2 pending. Link: https://redwood/company/onboarding/packet/1751

Raj (Talent Ops): Pending are rafael.m + sheng.l (missing SSN verification). I emailed them. ETA EOD Fri.

Olivia (Legal): Legal note — for remote CA hires we need the new state-specific W-4 & DE 4 forms filled before payroll cutoff. @Mia pls confirm which hires are CA.

Mia (People Ops): Rafael is CA, Sheng is WA. Rafael needs in-person I-9 verification (because remote + CA policy). We have options: local I-9 agent or campus office. I'll coordinate.

Chris (Eng Manager): For D0 IT, @Sam said he can do 10:30 PT. Sam?

Sam (IT): Yep can do 10:30 PT. I'll run through account checklist and do device provisioning. Please add internal ticket numbers to Jira: ORG-9876 ORG-9877

Mia (People Ops): Putting the D0 schedule here:
```
09:50 - new hires join lobby
10:00 - Chris team intro (10m)
10:10 - HR forms & benefits (Mia) (20m)
10:30 - IT setup (Sam) (20m)
10:50 - Legal policy signoff (Olivia) (15m)
11:05 - Manager 1:1 & wrap (Chris) (25m)
```
Link to slides: https://redwood.slides/d0-onboard

Emma K: Quick Q — I submitted my I-9 docs yesterday through ADP, is that enough?

Onboarding-bot: I-9 submitted via ADP by Emma K. Verification required: physical document review by authorized reviewer within 3 days.

Mia (People Ops): Emma — we have 2 options: come to SF office Mon 9:30 for 5-min check or send notarized documents (not preferred). Which works?

Emma K: I'll pop into SF office — thanks.

Raj (Talent Ops): I'll follow up with Rafael & Sheng and cc hiring managers. If any BG checks turn up issues, we'll flag in this thread.

Olivia (Legal): Also FYI — background checks show an expunged record for one candidate; legal reviewed, no action needed. I'll annotate the candidate file.

Chris (Eng Manager): Great. Anything else? Do we need badges printed?

Sam (IT): Badge order for remote SF pickups: I'll request via facilities. ETA 48 hrs. Please add names to ORG-9878.

Mia (People Ops): Thanks team. If anyone runs into blockers tonight DM me. :thumbsup:
